items:
About this space

WaterColor's best kept secret! NEW construction!

Just 3 HOUSES from the WATERCOLOR BRIDGE, The Boathouse, Cerulean Park, The Wine Bar & The Beach Club! Possibly the NICEST finished home in WaterColor! Professionally decorated with custom furnishings in a quiet, prime location - one minute to the ultra-desirable Frog Pond Pool, lake and park!

6-seater LSV/golf cart, 6 bikes & inclusive access to all WaterColor pools + amenities INCLUDED!

This is a 30A beach vacation dream home! Sleeps up to 20!

The space

Welcome to 'Rising Star!' This house truly has everything anyone could want in a vacation home - from the complimentary 6-seater LSV/golf cart, 6 complimentary YOLO bikes, private heated pool AND HOT TUB, two front porches each with two porch swings for relaxing after a day at the beach, a 3rd porch overlooking the pool and outdoor grilling area, gourmet open concept chef's kitchen plus expansive living spaces inside and out!

Situated just STEPS from the bridge in a quiet corner of WaterColor, this house is in an ultra-prime location (you may not even use your car once)! Surrounded by lush landscaping, bike trails and walking paths through shade trees, steps from fountains, lakes, a fishing dock, climbing trees in the front yard and more!

This is an exceptional vacation home for a large family, corporate retreat (all bedrooms with en suite bathrooms), girls/guys weekend away, multiple family vacation, or a multi-generational vacation.

'Rising Star' features Tempur-Pedic mattresses and smart TVs in every bedroom, the fastest WiFi available, and many more wonderful features to enhance your stay.

It is equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel Thermador appliances, 2 dishwashers, gorgeous custom designer decor, outdoor spaces perfect for entertaining, dining and relaxing, plus complimentary board games for the family's enjoyment. There are also complimentary beach chairs and toys for guests' use (or you can arrange for beach chair setup through WaterColor).

This spacious (5,300sf+) home has a very open floor plan with plenty of separate (or combined) spaces for all ages to spread out comfortably. The home has marble counter tops throughout, a massive breakfast bar with seating and eat-in kitchen, adjoining butler's pantry with large wine fridge, a large dining area with seating for 12+ with doors that open to the front porch, a private heated pool and adjoining hot tub flanked by a fountain water feature, built-in outdoor kitchen with grill and ice maker, outdoor shower, a carriage house (with the option to attach/detach from the main house), and more!

The main house has 7 defined sleeping areas (all with full en suite bathrooms) plus 2 half bathrooms, which includes 4 spacious king suites. There is a first floor master and 3 masters on the second floor, the main one of which has its own private balcony with two porch swings overlooking the scenic WaterColor trails and trees. There is also a queen bedroom with en-suite bathroom on the second floor.

The carriage house has 1 bedroom and another full en suite bathroom, and its own living area (with queen size sleeper sofa), wet bar and full laundry room (sleeps 4).

The 3rd floor has one large bedroom with full en suite bathroom that has built-in twin over twin size bunks (2 sets) and two additional twin size beds (sleeps 6). The third floor media room also has a queen size sleeper sofa.

When taking a break from enjoying the wonderful WaterColor amenities, this house has a picturesque outdoor living space complete with a private pebble-tec swimming pool and hot tub, built-in outdoor kitchen, fire table, outdoor TV, outdoor shower (with hot water), and a beautiful lounge seating area. There is corn hole to play, too! Alternatively, retreat to one of the four swing beds on the multiple porches to enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine.

One of the two garage bay's has been converted in to a game room with ping pong table and a couch - another great space for kids to relax. The other garage houses the LSV/golf cart. There is parking in the driveway for 6 cars.

HOME AMENITIES:
-Prime WaterColor location (Lake District) STEPS to the bridge, WaterColor shops and restaurants and Beach Club!
-Easy walk to The Beach Club + Cerulean Park + shopping + dining
-Walking distance to Seaside (10-minute walk)
-3-minute LSV/golf cart ride to Camp WaterColor
-6-Seater decked-out LSV/golf cart included (has backup camera, bluetooth speakers)
-6 bikes
-Sonos sound system inside and outside
-Private, heated pool (October through April) and hot tub
-Outdoor built-in kitchen with lounge seating area
-2 front porches each with two porch swings
-Fully equipped high-end chef's kitchen
-Wine fridge
-Carriage house
-Tempur-Pedic mattresses
-Smart TVs in every bedroom
-Free high-speed WiFi

This house comes with a maximum of 16 wristbands, which per the WaterColor HOA limits the number we accommodate even though there are sleeping arrangements in the home for more. Children under 5 are not required to wear a wristband so are not included in this number.

There is parking for 6 cars in the driveway, or pads located throughout the community.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 20 Guests):

FIRST FLOOR
-Master bedroom with King bed + en suite bathroom with double vanities and large glass shower
-Half bathroom
-Stackable washer/dryer

SECOND FLOOR
-Master bedroom with King bed + en suite bathroom with double vanities and large glass shower and separate soaking tub + private porch access
-Master bedroom with King bed + en suite bathroom with double vanities and large glass shower
-Queen bedroom + en suite bathroom with tub/shower combo
-2 washers/dryers

CARRIAGE HOUSE
-Master bedroom with King bed + en suite bathroom with glass shower
-Living room with Queen-size sleeper sofa
-4th stackable washer/dryer

THIRD FLOOR:
-Large room with 4 built-in Twin-size bunk beds + 2 additional Twin-size beds + en suite bathroom with double vanities and large glass shower (sleeps 6)
-Separate living area with Queen-size sleeper sofa
-2nd half bathroom

There is also a pack n' play provided at no additional charge.

Guest access

The WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to 7 other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community, the closest of which is the wonderful (and quiet) Frog Pond Pool and park!

The Beach Club is just across the bridge (3 minute bike ride), making this home a dream to not have to worry about parking since it is an easy walk or even quicker bike ride! Camp WaterColor is about a 3-minute LSV/golf cart ride. The highly exclusive and stunning Phase III Lake District location of this home cannot be beat! These are large estate-style homes with a quiet, neighborhood feel - great for kids to play and ride bikes tucked away from busy roads. The pictures do not do the area justice!

The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an 'adults only' pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf!

Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for littler kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground.

The wristbands for access to all of these wonderful amenities are included in the nightly rate and are no additional charge to the guests.

Other things to note
-Beach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance.
-In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking. Please bear in mind that the HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here. Finally, the WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost.
-Please note we provide a starter set of supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dishwasher + laundry pods for your stay
-Weddings and other similar events are not allowed at this home.
-Check in is 4:00 PM & check out is 10:00 AM. These times are strict and late check out may be subject to another day's rental fees.
-Smoking is strictly prohibited
-All renters must be over 25 years of age, or if under age 25 must be accompanied by a parent/legal guardian
-Pool and hot tub/spa heating must be for the full duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check-in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation and is available October 1st - April 30th. After April 30, guests can still heat the spa or hot tub for the same daily rate.
-The LSV/golf cart is not to be driven past the town of Seagrove to the East or the town of Grayton Beach to the West. Resolving any issue from the LSV/golf cart battery dying because of the renters not charging it will be charged to the renters
-Damage that occurs will be collected from the renters.
-Southern Holiday Homes can not be held liable for any damage or injury to any persons caused by LSV/golf cart, pool, hot tub, bikes, or other amenities provided to guests.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Watercolor, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and on a lake. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
